countries.bucket_warning_text: Only new files go to the new bucket; existing files stay where they are. The bucket must already exist in MinIO. The change takes effect within ~10 minutes.

bucket_errors.invalid: 3–63 characters: lowercase letters, digits, «.» and «-»; must start and end with a letter or digit
bucket_errors.not_found: No such bucket in MinIO. Create it first.

countries.empty: No countries yet. Add the first one.
countries.guide_intro: To fill in a new country correctly:
countries.guide_step_ai: Send the sample below to an AI (ChatGPT, Gemini…).
countries.guide_step_country: Name the country in the request, e.g. «prepare it for Uzbekistan».
countries.guide_step_paste: Copy the AI's answer into the form.
countries.guide_step_flag: Flag: find the country on flagpedia.net → «Mini waving icon» → 72×54 px → download it and upload to «Flag».
